verdict.rationale: Users interact with the agent through an iPhone app, and saved tasks can be triggered via Siri, Shortcuts, widgets and Control Center. Nothing in the evidence shows an official CLI for driving the agent. The only scripts mentioned are flash.sh, which builds the firmware, and board_test.py, a BLE debugging harness. These are developer building blocks and adjacent tooling, not a CLI for AI-native use, so they earn no credit.
